definitions: A structure or framework on which something may be placed or supported.
A small stall or booth, especially for selling newspapers, refreshments, or other small articles.
A rack or frame for holding coats, hats, or umbrellas.
A raised platform for spectators at a sporting event or other public gathering.
A group of trees or plants growing in a particular area.
examples: He took a stand for his beliefs.
Place the book on a stand.
Buy a newspaper at the stand.
Hang your coat on the stand.
The crowd cheered from the stand.
